serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: …
???: Please leave a message.
You: …
You: Mom…{{wi}} I did something really stupid, I’m sorry…
You: I know that I promised you that I won’t die before you, that I won’t leave you alone now that dad is gone… I’m really sorry…
I’m sorry that I rarely visited you… it’s just that… I didn’t want to see the place where he died ever again…
You: There’s someone in my room, please take care of her…
You: I’m really, really sorry.
…
I can’t go to prison…
I will not survive there…
I shouldn’t have let anger take over my life…
I’m sorry…
